title: app-shell: Studio's Automations rail titles a policy-unbound schedule flow "Enabled · no trigger (run manually)", reading `bound: false` as "no trigger" where `FlowRuntimeState` says it cannot be read that way (objectui#9217 follow-up)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect, class (b), a seam where the spec's stated contract is not delivered. `reach:` a named real producer. By default, the automation engine's `getFlowRuntimeStates()` reports `enabled: true, bound: false, triggerType: 'schedule'` for every package-authored time-triggered flow: objectstack-ai/objectstack#17396 ruling G leaves `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED` unset. The UI door was measured at component level: `FlowStatusDot` rendered with the state the pillar builds.

Reader who acts: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it.

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`). It is the follow-up of objectui#9217 that the seat recorded in its answer `5919298624` and in ACCEPT `5920018476`, to be filed once objectui#11232 freed `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. objectui#11232 is closed (PR objectui#11265 merged). The evidence is the objectui#9217 dev's first-leg report `5918495690` (`out_of_scope_findings[0]`). The seat named it a sub-issue of objectui#9217. objectui#9217 is closed (PR objectui#11271), so it is filed as a standalone card that names its parent. ⛔ Not graded here.

Dedup: the 1,000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (read through REST and grepped locally), plus the 60 newest objectui issues and PRs:
- `FlowStatusDot`, `onUnbound`, `no trigger (run manually)` and `Automations rail` give 0 cards;
- the only hit is PR objectui#11271's body, which carries this finding.

## The contract text

`FlowRuntimeState` in the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0:
- `bound` is "false for a flow with no declared trigger (manual / screen flows) AND for one whose declared trigger type has no registered trigger — `triggerType` distinguishes the two";
- and on `reason`: "`bound: false` alone cannot be read as a defect". Consumers RENDER `reason` and ⛔ do not parse it.

## The defect (read at source at objectui `origin/main` `e420df310`)

`FlowStatusDot` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (about `:4164`) takes `{ enabled, bound }` only. The `AutomationsPillar` status map keeps only those two fields. The dot titles every `enabled && !bound` flow `engine.studio.auto.onUnbound`, which is "no trigger (run manually)". So:

- a time-triggered flow the deployment policy holds unbound (`triggerType: 'schedule'`, a platform `reason`) is told to its author as having **no trigger**;
- a declared trigger with no registered trigger is told the same;
- only a flow with no declared trigger (a manual or screen flow) is described correctly.

Measured at component level by the objectui#9217 dev: `FlowStatusDot` with the pillar's state for such a flow gives the title "Enabled · no trigger (run manually)" and the text "On".

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

It follows objectui#9217's ruling **B** (`5919298624`), which PR objectui#11271 delivered on the Setup page:
- The status map keeps `triggerType` and `reason` beside `enabled` / `bound`, reading `reason` defensively (a non-empty string, or absent).
- "No trigger (run manually)" is said only when `triggerType` says there is no declared trigger.
- A row carrying a `reason` shows the platform's string verbatim (in the dot's title), never parsed or compared, with no error styling.
- A row with neither renders exactly as today, and so does an older backend.
- ⛔ No new vocabulary beyond what the contract publishes; no copy of a platform sentence in source.
- **Pins:** a policy-unbound schedule flow does not read "no trigger"; a manual flow still does; a bound flow and a disabled flow are unchanged (the controls).
- **Serial:** it edits `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, which objectui#11272 (p1) also edits. It goes after objectui#11272.

Dedupe words: `FlowStatusDot` · `onUnbound` · `no trigger (run manually)` · `policy-unbound` · `triggerType` · `Automations rail` · `bound false`
